CLINICAL FEATURES OF TRICHOMONIASIS
Clinical Features
- Vaginal discharge: a white-yellow frothy discharge is characteristic
- Burning sensation
- Dysuria
- Dyspareunia
- The labia are often swollen
- The cervix may have punctuated haemorrhages producing a strawberry-
like surface when viewed with a colposcope
- Some men may have dysuria or a minimal urethral discharge and
balanoposthitis
- Co-infection with N. gonorrhoeaeis common
